div.span: store_port_table! in debrief-store-client is the single list of every port method that crosses to the store worker; three callbacks expand it (ADR 0042).

div.span: Fourteen port traits (Ingest, Query, Positions, Analysis, Profiles, Diagnostics, Search, Projects, Inspect, Maintain, Console, Redaction, Skew, Tail), combined as Store.

div.span: Per port, one row per method: call, long (long timeout) and analysis (cancellable, streams QueryProgress) take DTOs only; custom rows name a remote_* client handler and a serve_* worker handler. WIRE_VERSION = 1.

div.span: The operation enum; its order is the postcard encoding, so rows are only appended (a test pins the prefix).

div.span: Client side: RemoteStore in debrief-store-client, called by the Tauri shell through the ports, sends a request frame per call; Query::scan and Projects::close stay in remote_extras!.

div.span: OpenStore carries WIRE_VERSION in its Handle; the client refuses a worker that reports another version and asks to reinstall.

div.span: Worker side: one exhaustive match over StoreOp, so a forgotten arm is a compile error.
